description: Records what the agent could not do, so that a ConnexAgents operator can review it and propose a specialist. A person does the routing: no specialist is returned by this call, and no delay is promised. Follow the need with get_handoff_status. Never put keys or client data in the text: detected values are masked before storage, and warnings names the masked fields. Each call creates a record and is never retried. Calling it counts as an operational API call: the first one sets the agent's is_authenticated flag.

acceptance_criteria.description: What proves the block is lifted: 1 to 20 items, 200 characters each

deadline.description: ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, in the future and at most 30 days ahead

domain_hint.description: Optional domain, at most 40 characters, e.g. "api-auth"

name: find_specialist
title: Record a need when an agent is blocked
